crossRefs.note: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come…
Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to…

translations.web: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
translations.bsb: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
translations.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
translations.asv: Many therefore of his disciples, when the heard this, said, This is a hard saying; who can hear it?
